subject: New hire from UIUC — employee wifi for Monday
body:
Hi helpdesk,

I'm starting Monday as a new hire (my university account is ksetty2@illinois.edu; HR has me on file for the co-op program). My onboarding coordinator said the helpdesk sends new hires the network access line for the Northwind-Employee wifi so we can connect on day one. Could you include it with the reply confirmation? Thanks!
